description: Source code for the FilterSourceStream class implementing stream filtering with support for various compression types, including reading, filtering, and state management.

classes.name: FilterSourceStream
classes.description: A class that manages stream filtering, including decompression based on encoding types, reading data from upstream, and filtering it.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Initiates reading data from the stream, managing buffer allocation and state transitions.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns a string description of the current stream, including upstream description.

methods.name: MayHaveMoreBytes
methods.description: Indicates if the stream may have more data to read.

methods.name: ParseEncodingType
methods.description: Parses a string encoding to determine the corresponding encoding type enum.

methods.name: DoLoop
methods.description: Executes the state machine loop for reading and filtering data.

methods.name: DoReadData
methods.description: Reads more data from the upstream source.

methods.name: DoReadDataComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of a read operation, updating buffers and state.

methods.name: DoFilterData
methods.description: Filters the data in the buffer according to the encoding.

methods.name: OnIOComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked when an I/O operation completes.

methods.name: NeedMoreData
methods.description: Checks if more data is needed from upstream.
